name: Park Restoration
deck: The one campaign here whose subject we can already prove — a park in Vasant Kunj went from five per cent green cover to ninety over a decade. What we cannot prove is that this campaign is what did it.

holes.what: Eco Action holds the park figures: over seventy butterfly parks, over twenty herb gardens, and the Vasant Kunj decade. This campaign holds none of them, and we will not move a number onto a page it was not measured for.
holes.unlocks: Whether this campaign and Eco Action are the same work under two names. If they are, this becomes a section of that page rather than a row here.

holes.what: No date, no site list and no demand.
holes.unlocks: One park, one year, one thing that was asked for.
